_comment: The clip-level split. Handover principle 3: splits by clip, never by frame --
frames within a clip share the same window fouling, lighting and bubble
population, so a frame-level split leaks and reports a score that is partly
memorisation. Fixed BEFORE training, so it cannot be chosen after seeing a
result. Test clips cover all three spargers so recall by size band is testable
across the range; the 1440 rpm condition stays in training so the model is not
asked to generalise to an rpm it never saw.

val_clips is carved out of the training side for checkpoint selection only. The test clips are never looked at during training -- choosing a checkpoint on the test set is a quiet way of fitting to it.
